Definition: from G4625; to entrap, i.e. trip up (figuratively, stumble (transitively) or entice to sin, apostasy or displeasure):--(make to) offend.
BiblicalUsage: Skandalizo means to trip up, to offend, to make a brother stumble, and Jesus uses it with terrible seriousness. Whoever offends one of these little ones would be better drowned with a millstone, He speaks so His disciples will not be offended, and Paul says he will eat no flesh while the world stands if meat makes his brother offend.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a stumbling block is the one sin Jesus calls better drowned than done. I hold that my freedom ends where my brother's faith begins to trip.
